items.title: Pierre Boussaguet interviewed by Matthieu Jaffre, Aix en Provence, France, July 28, 2020
items.q: Slam Stewart used to do it with the Archer.

ctx.x: You too? In this record you can really feel the chemistry between the three of you. And in one tune, “Sister Jones,” you are kind of humming and scatting the notes while you are performing the solo. And this is a kind of a tradition like from the 40s. Slam Stewart used to do it with the Archer. So I was wondering, in this album, was it spontaneously that it came out? Did you plan it?

No I didn’t plan it. Sometimes I can describe, there is not a concept. Sometimes when I play a solo I might suddenly be feeling like if I am leaded by the voice. So I can [scats] — so it’s like basically unconsciously I’m playing what I am singing, or singing — some other time I don’t sing at all and I might be thinking about the line or a chord. And that day I remember that we were in the middle of the tune and it was — it’s one of these tunes where you don’t feel like you’re in the studio. You feel it’s like…
